title: Django, minimal settings
notes: Django with only what this application uses: no admin, sessions, auth, messages, CSRF middleware, context processors or database settings. WSGI on Waitress.
details: The Django entry (synchronous views, WSGI on Waitress with its default 4 threads) with what the shop does not use taken out by config/settings_minimal.py: INSTALLED_APPS is the shop alone (no admin, auth, contenttypes, sessions, messages, staticfiles) and the URLconf has no admin; the session, CSRF, authentication and message middleware are removed (the security, common and clickjacking middleware remain, since they set headers on every response); the templates have no context processors; DATABASES is empty.
